title: 1 Ailesbury Road, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4, D04A097
description:
Occupying a prime position on one of Ballsbridge’s most highly regarded residential roads, this exceptional Victorian residence combines the elegance and character of its period origins with the scale, comfort and sophistication of a fully modernised family home. Completely refurbished and thoughtfully extended, the property provides generous and versatile accommodation over four levels, including six bedrooms, five elegant reception rooms and an impressive open-plan kitchen, living and dining space at garden level. A beautifully landscaped south-facing rear garden and extensive off-street parking for up to eight cars, framed by magnificent, mature beech trees, further enhance this outstanding home.

Behind its handsome Victorian façade, the property retains a wealth of period character while providing exceptional contemporary family accommodation. At hall level, the welcoming entrance hall leads to three well-proportioned reception rooms, offering excellent spaces for formal entertaining, dining and family living, together with a butler’s service area. Also at this level there is a generous study and cloakroom. Up from there off the half landing is a bright generous bedroom and family bathroom.

The top floor provides three bedrooms, two with en-suite bathrooms, while the garden level accommodates two additional bedrooms, both with en-suites. This level also features a dedicated family room, extensive storage, a wine cellar and a large utility room, together with a spectacular extended kitchen, living and dining space. Two full-height sliding doors provide a seamless connection to the beautifully landscaped south-facing garden, creating an exceptional setting for both family life and entertaining.

Particular care has been taken to integrate the original house with its contemporary additions, creating a home of considerable style, scale and versatility. The generous front garden provides rare off-street parking for up to eight cars, while the mature beech trees create an impressive approach.

Ballsbridge is one of Dublin’s most prestigious residential suburbs, renowned for its leafy streets, period architecture and exceptional convenience. The property is ideally positioned close to Herbert Park, the RDS, Aviva Stadium and the amenities of Ballsbridge, Donnybrook and Sandymount. Dublin city centre is readily accessible, while Sandymount Strand and the coast are also within easy reach.

Excellent public transport links include the DART at Sydney Parade and regular bus services along the Merrion and Stillorgan Roads, with convenient access to the city’s road network and Port Tunnel. A superb selection of schools is nearby, including St. Michael’s College, St. Andrew’s College, Blackrock College and Muckross Park College.

Outside The front garden is a notable feature of the property, approached via a generous gravel driveway providing off-street parking for up to eight cars. The driveway is framed by two magnificent specimen beech trees, with mature hedging and planting providing privacy and a particularly attractive setting. Granite steps lead to the front entrance, while a side gate provides access to the rear garden and garden level. Useful under-stairs storage is also provided.
The private south-facing rear garden is beautifully landscaped and provides an ideal setting for outdoor entertaining and family enjoyment. A stone-paved patio leads to raised planted borders and steps ascending to a well-maintained lawn. Mature trees, shrubs and hedging surround the garden, creating a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion, while a timber garden shed provides additional storage.
